name: Data-Hunter Protocol
summary: Data-Hunter Protocol; Gain expertise in Investigation or Technology. Once per short rest, identify one weakness, resistance, or tactical feature of an enemy you can observe.  Data-Hunter; The next ally to damage the identified enemy adds +1d6 damage.  Data-Hunter; Your identified target loses one resistance of the GM’s choice against the next damage it takes.  Data-Hunter; Your identified target grants +1 to allied attack rolls until your next turn.
descriptionMarkdown:
Data-Hunter Protocol; Gain expertise in Investigation or Technology. Once per short rest, identify one weakness, resistance, or tactical feature of an enemy you can observe.

Data-Hunter; The next ally to damage the identified enemy adds +1d6 damage.

Data-Hunter; Your identified target loses one resistance of the GM’s choice against the next damage it takes.

Data-Hunter; Your identified target grants +1 to allied attack rolls until your next turn.
